provenance.section_ref: Annex Table 3 — inverted as positive pass/fail criteria
provenance.derivation_note: Checkpoints are DERIVED from defect_types — each BCA defect description inverted into 'what to verify passes'. Verify the check_mode copy reads well to an inspector in the field; underlying defect_type remains the contractually authoritative label.

review.review_notes: Inspector-facing copy. Review for readability + field-use; underlying defect_type_ids remain BCA-verbatim.

intent: Guided LOG flow: user picks element → walks through these checkpoints in order → marks pass/fail + photo on fail. The check_mode flag enables a different UI from free-form defect entry.

items.pass_criteria: Visual — no staining visible under normal lighting
Visual — tiles / planks / slabs visually aligned
Visual — joint widths and grouting even

items.description: Floor is free of scratches, dents, chips
items.pass_criteria: Visual — no surface damage on finished floor
Measured — deviation ≤ 6mm over 1.2m straightedge

items.description: Tiled floor has no hollow spots
items.pass_criteria: Tap test — no hollow sound on any tile (pass = solid throughout)

items.description: Floor has no structural cracks or open veins
items.pass_criteria: Visual + feel — no cracks or open veins >0.5mm wide AND >100mm long
Visual — no chipped timber anywhere on floor
Visual — zero delamination spots
Visual + feel — tile edges flush with neighbours
Visual — no visible cracks on plastered surface

items.description: Wall finish is free of patchiness/roughness

Visual — elements aligned (skirting, corners, features)
Visual — joint widths and profiles even

items.description: Wall corner squareness is within tolerance
